cohort: A total of 40 patients experiencing severe intractable postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) at >=24 weeks gestational age, where conservative management failed, were retrospectively reviewed.
finding: Bilateral hypogastric artery ligation (HAL) was found to be an effective life-saving procedure for severe intractable postpartum hemorrhage, controlling hemorrhage in 88.9% of cases and avoiding hysterectomy.
